text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus had been invited by Mejiro 
McQueen to accompany her in purchasing 
horseshoes for training, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um, purely for reference, but would there 
happen to be horseshoes specialized for 
body slimming and toning...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see. If that is your objective, there is 
something I would wholeheartedly 
recommend—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... forgive me. Such a question 
would be better directed to the store 
clerk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
? ...Ikuno-san. Are you perhaps not 
feeling well?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: No, it is nothing like that, however...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In that case, please do tell me more! I 
would truly love to learn your horseshoe 
knowledge...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No. When it comes to horseshoes, I tend to 
lose self-control and talk far too much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Self-control, you say... In that case, 
allow me to lend you my assistance, desu 
wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If I feel you are talking too much, I 
shall simply stop you... How does that 
sound?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, doing so would be an 
inconvenience to you, McQueen-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Whatever are you saying? Both when I tried 
to eat sweets during dietary restrictions, 
and when I stayed up late watching 
baseball...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Was it not you who stopped me when I 
lacked self-control, Ikuno-san?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That is... true, but.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please allow me to return the favor for 
once.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If you insist to such a degree... 
Understood. Then――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You desire training horseshoes specialized 
for body shaping... Is this correct?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, forgive me. Was I talking too much 
right off the bat?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...No. That is precisely the side of you I 
wished to see! Please, give me everything 
you have!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
! ...In that case, there are several 
applicable horseshoes in that section over 
there. Come, let us inspect them 
firsthand――
A few days later――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wait, please... Not here, I beg of you―!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san, please do not run away. It is 
time for your horseshoe inspection!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer... You see, regarding this――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...And so, as the one who selected the 
horseshoes, I have a duty to stand by her 
and keep watch at all times...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is... if pressed for a reason, 
perhaps because I was delighted when the 
same was done for me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In my youth, when my legs were weak, a 
certain farrier crafted special horseshoes 
specifically for me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That farrier stood by my side for the 
exact same reason I stated earlier.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Their passion and attitude were so 
inspiring... That is why I, too, wish to 
be like them...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...That is the first time I have heard 
this story.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, I got carried away... I talked 
too much again, did I not?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Not in the least, desu wa. It was a 
wonderful story. So much so that I wish to 
hear more...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Then how about this? In exchange for 
undergoing the horseshoe check, please 
tell me more of your stories, Ikuno-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: My stories, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Getting to know each other... Is that 
not what standing by someone truly means?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
! ...Indeed. Understood. Though I may be 
an unpolished storyteller, I look forward 
to sharing with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Likewise, I shall be counting on 
you, along with my horseshoes, desu wa.
